:::{#exr-identity-matrix-shape}
#### Whether a matrix with the identity pattern is an identity matrix

An [identity matrix](#def-identity-matrix) has ones on its [main diagonal](#def-main-diagonal) and zeros elsewhere.
The [matrix](#def-matrix) below has the same pattern of ones and zeros.
Let

$$
\matr{J} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

Is $\matr{J}$ an identity matrix?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Compare the shape of $\matr{J}$ with the shape of $\matr{I}_p$ in @def-identity-matrix.

:::

:::
